author: __Proxy
body:
Format:

Age:16

Timezone:UTC

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No:Yes

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: No

 

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

 

Do you have any experience as a staff member on Avicus or any other server? No, I have not been a staff member of Avicus. I have been staff on other servers such as, Moderator and helper.

 

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? I feel my biggest weakness is that I'm a workaholic and it is bad for me at times but I try to lay off internet or any devices that are electronic.

 

What is the biggest weakness for the Avicus Staff Team. How do you believe you can help improve the weakness? I think the biggest weakness for the Avicus Staff Team is they need to be more active and interact. I'm not saying all staff member's are not active I'm just saying some of them are. I believe I could improve this weakness by getting the staff online and hangout and jump from game to game and just having a great experience with the staff.

 

What biggest qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? The biggest qualities a leader should have is one Focus because that's what you need to lead a great group of people and also confidence because without confidence people are just gonna run over and think they can over-power you which obviously is not the case.

 

What three attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? One attribute is Personal skills which I don't believe a lot of people have today, an example of personal skills are integrity, friendly, calm, and so on. The second attribute is Passion because even though this is a block game yes I am still very passionate about this. The third and final attribute is flexibility because you need to able to be flexible towards your situations.

 

When interacting with the community, what skills do you believe you should have when interacting? Do you believe you have these skills or you do need to work on them? The skills you should have when interacting with the community is being able to talk friendly and to acknowledge everyone. I believe I need to work on these skills but I know I have them I just need to work on them a bit.

 

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

 

A group of players are repeatedly joining the support room channels on TeamSpeak to troll, you are the only staff member online, what do you do? If I were the only staff member I would ban them from the Teamspeak for a certain amount of time and to see if they would learn there lesson or not and if they comeback and continuously repeat to do it I would ban them permanently.


On Teamspeak, A player is threatening to DDoS players in the NightClub channel and telling others to kill themselves. What would be the best course of action to do? The best course of action to do in my opinion would to ban them automatically because no one should be threatening another player online who didn't do anything to that player. Also, I would make sure that player doesn't do that in the Avicus Server.

A player you have banned has decided to appeal their punishment. It has been 2 weeks since their punishment was made. They claim that they have not hacked and they were lagging. While looking for evidence, you have noticed that the video has been corrupted and cannot be viewed. You, and a handful of players on at the time, know that this player was hacking and flying around. What would be the best action to take on their appeal? The best action for me would to let them play again and if they start hacking again I would get video of them hacking and then ban them permanently and if he/she wants to appeal i'll have more evidence on them. I would show them the video footage and other staff members so they know that this person was actually hacking.

Your friend is being harassed via Skype by another Avicus player. This player is notorious for harassing players and has decided to take all his anger out on your friend in a Skype conversation they were having. As a staff member on the server, what would you do? As a staff member I would respectfully go to that player and calmly ask them what is going on. I would ask what problem they have and if i could help in anyway possible, and to see if it's a family problem or girlfriend or boyfriend problem I would ask them and I would be so happy to help them. If they needed anything else I would be there for them anytime and I would ask them to please not harass anymore player's.

 

It's staff feedback day and you decide to ask players on skype for feedback regarding how you are as a staff member and how you can improve as one. You get a response from a player and they swear at you while calling you a "Terrible Moderator" and saying that you suck at dealing punishments and are too afraid to be judged by your peers. This is a player that you despise. While reading the feedback, you realize that all the claims they made are false (from your point of view). What would you do with this feedback and what would you tell the player regarding what they gave you? What I would do with the feed back they gave me is to improve all of that negativity even if it is true or false. I would show that I am a great moderator and do those things better than before. What I would say to this player is that all of his feedback may be true in his eyes but in my eyes it is false and I would also tell him or her that I will still improve in all this negative feedback you've sent me and thank you for your time have a great day. 

 

Do you have anything else to add to your application? No, just thank for your time.
